profile_text.body:
IBM is a publicly traded technology company founded in 1911 and headquartered in Armonk, NY. Its website for the OpenPages product describes IBM OpenPages as a scalable, AI-powered governance, risk, and compliance platform that helps organizations manage risk, compliance, and audit functions in a single integrated solution, available on any cloud or on-premises. The site describes a modular approach to GRC that allows organizations to deploy only the components they need, and it highlights features including an interactive workspace called the OpenPages GRC Canvas, embedded AI for automating classification and issue creation, and an OpenPages MCP Server intended to enable AI agents to create, query, and update GRC objects. The site notes that Citi partnered with IBM to automate its internal audit process using AI and machine learning, and that IDC recognized IBM as a leader in the IDC MarketScape: Worldwide AI-Enabled Financial Governance, Risk, and Compliance 2026 Vendor Assessment.

IBM's tracked AI products include IBM OpenPages with Watson, described as a full GRC platform with AI-specific modules covering risk assessment, regulatory mapping, and Watson AI automated documentation, and IBM watsonx.governance, which covers AI lifecycle governance, model evaluation, monitoring, and documentation, with EU AI Act accelerators. IBM watsonx.governance was named a Leader in Gartner's first AI Governance Platforms Magic Quadrant in June 2026. The company also offers IBM watsonx, an enterprise AI platform described as model-agnostic and incorporating agent inventory, behavior monitoring, and hallucination detection capabilities.

IBM files with the SEC under CIK 0000051143 and trades under the ticker IBM. Its most recently filed 10-K, covering the period ending December 31, 2025, reported revenue of $67,535,000,000. No litigation or MCP registry entries are recorded in the held facts.
